visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a young woman with long blonde hair, wearing a burgundy knit beanie and a brown-and-white striped off-the-shoulder sweater. She poses for the camera with a playful expression, surrounded by digital graphic overlays showing chocolate squares, roasted coffee beans, and a hot mocha drink, establishing the mocha-inspired makeup theme. The background is a bright, minimally decorated indoor room with soft studio lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a series of focused close-up shots demonstrating the base and brow routine. She holds a gold Guerlain cushion compact and a Kuromi-themed mirror, carefully dabbing the product onto her face using a puff. Her movements are deliberate and precise. She then introduces a Laka brow mascara and applies it with upward strokes, shaping her eyebrows while looking intently at her reflection. (3) The narrative continues with the eye makeup application. She presents a Moody eyeshadow stick and applies it to her eyelids, followed by a Lilybyred gel eyeliner to define her lash line. She then shows a Moody mascara tube and wand, meticulously coating her upper and lower lashes to create a volumized, fan-like effect. Text captions appear on-screen to explain the waterproof and long-lasting features of the products. (4) Moving to the complexion, she dabs a bright red fwee cream blush onto her cheeks and the tip of her nose with a small puff, creating a youthful, flushed appearance. She then uses a fluffy brush to apply Guerlain bronzer from a gold compact to her cheekbones and jawline. Finally, she sets her makeup with a large brush and Make Up For Ever translucent powder, ensuring a smooth, matte finish under the bright lighting. (5) The final phase features the lip makeup and the completed look. She layers two shades of Laka lip tints, resulting in a glossy, reddish-brown mocha hue. After a few final contouring adjustments to her nose, she poses for the camera in her original outfit, now with full makeup. She puts on dark-framed sunglasses and offers various poses, showcasing the completed aesthetic against a soft-focus home background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio consists of a high-fidelity Korean pop track featuring a bright, energetic female vocal lead. The instrumentation is driven by a crisp electronic drum beat and rhythmic synthesizer melodies. The tempo is moderate, creating an upbeat and inviting atmosphere. No speech or dialogue from the creator is present, nor are there any ambient noises or foley effects from the makeup tools, indicating a purely music-driven production. (2) As the video enters the main makeup application phases, the music maintains its steady pulse, serving as a rhythmic anchor for the frequent visual cuts. The vocal melody becomes more intricate with varied pitch contours during a pre-chorus section, enhancing the sense of progression and excitement. The balance between the vocals and the instrumental stems is clear and professional. (3) During the final reveal, the song reaches its chorus, featuring a denser harmonic arrangement and more powerful vocal delivery. The beat remains strong and consistent until the very end, where the track begins a subtle fade out as the woman finishes her final pose. The entire audio experience is studio-clean, with zero incidental interference.
